body:
## Summary

- Enforce one leading `recording_started` and one final clean `recording_closed` event.
- Reject duplicate, non-leading, missing, unclean, or post-close lifecycle events before exposing a replay.
- Preserve the existing public replay API, timestamp/PCM behavior, and error identity.

## Validation

- `go test -C go-audio ./pkg/recording -count=1 -timeout=60s` — PASS
- `go test -C go-audio -race ./pkg/recording -count=1 -timeout=120s` — PASS
- `go vet -C go-audio ./pkg/recording` — PASS
- Public consumer baseline at `1f82284` — reproduces the pre-fix post-close acceptance.
- Candidate lifecycle verification and negative control — PASS.
- Exact public `yui` replay regression — PASS: 15 wire events, 0 tool calls; rendered PCM 3360 bytes, SHA-256 `302e7421a29a4868a0a1a2f1ca2e8432c9015a6475412ec63fe2b15414f469ff`.
- Final ancestry and owned-path scope are clean.

The accumulated public integration selector was attempted but stopped before compilation because the host reported `no space left on device`; this is not a product assertion. The direct public replay regression above passed. CI remains script-owned and has not been polled.

Revision: `ee15be2f`.
title: fix(recording): reject replay events outside session lifecycle
